_comment: Manual layout spec for the Neno Engineering Focus board. The daily 6am job MERGES live Linear data into THIS fixed structure for the initiative view, and uses each initiative's context_sources to build the context page (context.json). Buckets encode commitments for the month named in period_label: 'now' = committed AND in progress; 'next' = committed, not yet started; 'later' = not committed. The 'Other commitments' card is static (no Linear initiative): the job must leave it untouched and skip it when building context.json. Cards listed in hidden_but_synced_initiatives have no board card but the job still refreshes their memory/context.json and Linear write-back. Edit this file to change curation. The engineer view is fully auto-generated from Linear. Restructured 4 Aug 2026 (Matthew): board is now the four tracked initiatives - source of truth for bookkeeping data, source of truth for bookkeeping activity, make accountants more efficient during onboarding and customer collaboration (renamed from 'Centralise customer data' in Linear too), enable accountants to complete VAT submissions via double-entry GL - plus the static 'Other commitments' card, all five side by side. The leave calendar moved below the board and is rebuilt monthly from Matthew's Google Calendar. Ihor's holiday ended 31 Jul so he is available for August.
title: Engineering Focus

merge_rules.initiative_view: Keep buckets and item order exactly as defined below. For items with a projectId, refresh owner (project lead) and status from Linear at run time. Do NOT re-bucket automatically. Buckets encode the current month's commitments: now = in progress, next = committed for the month, later = not committed. The month shown in the bucket headings comes from period_label. Cards with static:true have no Linear initiative - skip them for context.json and needs-triage.
merge_rules.new_projects: If a NEW project appears under one of the tracked initiatives in Linear that is not listed below, surface it in a 'Needs triage' note on that card rather than placing it.
merge_rules.removed_projects: If a listed projectId is completed/cancelled/missing in Linear, render it struck-through with a '(check)' flag.
merge_rules.engineer_view: Fully regenerate from Linear each run: non-archived issues with statusType 'started' that have an assignee, grouped assignee -> initiative -> project -> issue. Ungrouped items go under 'Not belonging to an initiative'.
merge_rules.context_view: For each initiative, build context.json using context_sources: Linear (status updates + issue activity + project descriptions), Granola (folder_id if set, else keyword queries), and Slack (the listed channels filtered by keywords). Lookback window = 14 days. Summarize into the sections defined in context.html. Cache results in context.json; do not summarize on page open.

team_note: The engineer view renders one lane per person in the fixed roster - Dima, Mark, Joel, Ihor - in that order, even if they have no issues. The daily job matches Linear assignees to these by email/name. David left 6 Jul 2026. The leave calendar covers the same four people so the two views line up.
